summary: v1.11.0 Step 6 (Research artifacts + paid promotion) + Step 7 (Payouts/W9/Method). 32/32 backend tests PASS (100%). Frontend smoke verified: /research lists both seeded artifacts with tier badges/read-time/DOI/tags/Read-full-text links; search filters re-fetch correctly; /partners shows Featured strip wired in; /dashboard/partner/research renders for research partners with tier pricing copy + New artifact CTA; /dashboard/partner/payouts shows 3 tabs (Ledger/W9 form/Payout method) with totals + empty-state; nav 'Research' link sits between Featured and Join Us.

ui_bugs.issue: In the rendered header, the 'birthright' wordmark visually overlaps the first nav item ('Workshops'). The two pieces of text are painted on top of each other. Visible in every screenshot. Likely a flex/grid alignment or negative-margin regression in the header brand block. Pre-existing across iter17 screenshots too, but worth re-flagging.

action_items: Fix Layout/header brand-vs-nav overlap (cosmetic but visible in every page screenshot).
critical_code_review_comments: routers/research.py list_artifacts performs three sorts in a row (lines 99-103). The first two sorts are dead code — only the final promoted+others composition is used. Cleanup recommended for readability but functionally correct.

routers/research.py admin_set_tier uses Query(regex=...). On Pydantic v2 / FastAPI 0.110+ this should be `pattern=` instead of `regex=` — current code still works (regex is aliased) but emits a deprecation warning.

routers/payouts.py admin_get_w9 audit-logs view but returns full TIN unredacted; correctly gated to admin role. Consider also returning a `tin_last4` even on the admin response so frontend can avoid re-rendering the full SSN unless explicitly requested.
routers/payouts.py _fernet() raises HTTPException(500) when key missing — good; but the key is loaded on every encrypt/decrypt call. Minor: cache the Fernet instance at module load.

models.PayoutMethodSet validates routing_number length=9 but does not validate it's digits-only; account_number min=4 max=20 also accepts non-numeric. Acceptable for scaffolding but should add `pattern=r'^\d+$'` before production.
routers/research.py promote_checkout writes payment_transactions row with status='open' and payment_status='initiated' — consistent with iter17 featured pattern. Good.

research.py _require_research_profile returns 400 for is_sample profiles — verified at API level. UI does not appear to handle this 400 explicitly for the create flow; an alert/toast would be a polish item.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (research listing + search + partner research + partner payouts + nav + partners featured strip all verified)
